systemWorkspaceError: Cannot browse the system space. Check your permissions and its availability.
gitLocalCleanRequired: Commit your changes before switching or merging branches.
gitLocalActionHelp: Local operation only, without publishing. The copy must be clean and agents idle. No force or automatic stash. Conflicting merges are rejected without changing files.
gitLocalConflict: Automatic merge unavailable (conflict, incompatible history or unsupported Git). No files were changed.
gitLocalCustomDriver: Custom merge drivers are not allowed for this operation.
gitRefreshAllHelp: Refresh local, GitHub and synchronization data without fetching, pulling or changing files.
gitRemoteReadOnlyHelp: Remote file from GitHub at the displayed revision. Editing and saving are unavailable; local files remain unchanged.
gitCreateBranchHelp: Creates a branch in this local copy only. Nothing is published to or fetched from GitHub.
gitBranchSwitchHelp: Switching is refused when files are modified or an agent is working. Remote references listed here are already known locally.
gitBranchCreated: Local branch “{{name}}” created. The active branch is unchanged.
gitBranchExists: A local branch already has this name. It was not modified.
gitBranchDirty: Commit your changes before switching, or create the branch without switching.
gitNoAgentCopy: No local copy for this agent
gitRemoteGraphHelp: Remote GitHub history, without a local copy or Git fetch. Up to 8 branches and 100 commits; dashed lines indicate parents outside the view. Local references are not modified.
gitRemoteFilesHelp: Read-only on GitHub. Navigation stays at the displayed revision. Refresh returns to the root at the latest revision without changing local files.
gitRemoteEmpty: This repository or folder is empty.
gitRemoteNoPreview: Preview unavailable: binary file, symbolic link, or file larger than 128 KiB.
gitStageReviewHelp: Review the content to prepare. This does not commit or send anything to GitHub. Preparation is rejected if a file changes meanwhile. External Git filters are not executed.
gitStageHelp: Prepare the files to include, then use Commit… to create a local commit. Removing a file from the commit preserves its working changes. Push afterwards from Synchronization.
gitStageError: Cannot prepare changes: refresh and review the files again. An active agent, concurrent edit, conflict or unsupported file may block the operation.
gitStageDeletion: This file deletion will be recorded in the next commit.
gitStageBinary: Binary file: the entire content will be prepared without a text preview.
gitStageTruncated: Preview limited to the first 64 KiB; the entire file will be prepared.
gitAgentCopyExists: This agent already has a local copy. To choose another, first select the managed local space and release the current copy’s reservation.
gitCopyOwnedByAgent: Copy reserved for this work agent
gitCopyOwnedElsewhere: Copy reserved for another agent — browsing only
gitCopyUnassigned: Unassigned copy — use it for this agent to reserve it.
gitCopyReleaseActive: To release this copy, first select the managed local space as the working directory.
gitCopyReleaseHelp: The copy, commits and local changes will be preserved. It will no longer be reserved for this agent and can be assigned to another. No files or GitHub repository will be deleted.
gitCopyReleaseError: Cannot release this copy: ensure no agent is using it and no operation is running.
gitGraphHelp: Local copy history, local branches and already known remote refs (☁). Lines link commits to their parents, including merges. Select a commit for details. No automatic fetch or branch switch.
gitGraphLimited: History is limited to the latest 100 commits. Dashed lines indicate a parent outside this preview.
gitPushWriteAccessDenied: GitHub refuses write access to this repository (forbidden). Check that the token selects this repository and grants Contents read and write access, along with any GitHub restrictions. No force push was performed.
gitConnectionEditHelp: Change the name or replace credentials for this connection. The remote repository, connection permissions and local copies remain unchanged. The address is kept to avoid sending a token to another destination.
gitConnectionSecretPresent: Credentials are already stored. They are never displayed.
gitConnectionSecretAbsent: No credentials are stored for this connection.
gitConnectionTokenHelp: Leave blank to keep existing credentials. For GitHub, use a token limited to this repository with Contents read and write access. A new token replaces stored credentials; nothing is sent until you save.
gitConnectionHttpsOnly: Replacing credentials with a token is available only for HTTPS Git connections. Existing credentials will be preserved.
gitConnectionSaved: Connection saved. You can now test it or resume publication.
gitConnectionSaveFailed: Unable to save the connection. Check your permissions and retry. The token field was cleared for security; enter it again if needed.
gitPushAuthRequired: GitHub authentication or write access was refused. Configure a token with repository contents write access for this connection. Credentials are never taken from the agent session.
gitPushRejected: The remote rejected publication: check new commits and branch protections. No force push was performed.
gitPushNetworkUnavailable: The server cannot reach the remote repository. Check the network and proxy before retrying.
gitPushTlsError: The remote certificate cannot be verified. TLS verification remains enabled.
gitCopyDeleteHelp: Only this local copy will be removed from the project. Its files, changes and local commits will be preserved in a recoverable local trash folder. The remote repository, its branches and other copies remain unchanged. A copy used by an agent or another resource cannot be removed: change its working directory first.
gitCopyInUse: Copy in use: first select another working directory for the affected agents or resources.
gitCopyDeleteFailed: Could not remove this copy. Refresh the list and check that it is available and not in use.
gitRemoteReadHelp: Data read from GitHub. This view changes neither local files nor the agent’s working directory.
gitKnownTracking: ↑ {{ahead}} · ↓ {{behind}} against {{upstream}}. Unsynchronized local references; local inspection at {{date}}.
gitNoTrackingComparison: No reliable remote comparison: no upstream or local state unavailable.
gitRefreshRemoteHelp: Refreshes GitHub only, without fetch, pull or local changes.
gitIntegrateUnavailable: Local integration unavailable. No automatic pull.
gitLocalCommitsHelp: Local branch history, including already-published commits. Creating a local commit does not automatically send it to GitHub.
executionLocationUnavailable: This local location is no longer available. Refresh the project locations before selecting it.
localLocationsDescription: The local space managed by Mergeron and other local folders attached to this project. Remote connections are listed separately.
managedLocalDescription: The managed local space is the project’s permanent primary location. Working files are separate from internal data in the .mergeron directory, reserved for the application and hidden by default in the file listing.
systemFilesHidden: Mergeron internal data is hidden in this listing.
systemFilesVisible: Technical view of Mergeron internal data.
systemFilesTechnicalHelp: The .mergeron directory is reserved for the application. This view changes neither your permissions nor existing protections. Project files, including .git and .env, are not hidden by this option.
gitCloneFailed: Could not create the copy. Check repository access and the requested branch.
gitUnbornDiffHelp: Before the first commit, only staged changes are displayed. Unstaged changes are not included.
detachResourceDescription: This only removes the resource connection from the project. The remote repository and all remote and local files will NOT be deleted. Associated working copies will be marked as revoked and will no longer be available to agents; their files will be kept.
gitResourceMissing: This resource is no longer available.
gitDisabledHelp: This connection is disabled. Enable it in the project’s Locations and connections tab.
gitLocalSnapshot: Local snapshot; refresh does not fetch from the remote.
gitNoCopy: The remote is connected. Prepare a working copy to browse and work locally.
gitCopyHelp: Creates an isolated clone. The current agent's workspace and files remain unchanged.
gitInspectionError: Unable to inspect this copy. Refresh or check its availability.
gitBrowseError: Unable to open the files in this copy.
gitBrowseHelp: Browsing does not change the agent’s active working directory.
gitNoSnapshot: Prepare a copy and refresh to inspect Git.
gitBranchesHelp: Local branches in this copy. Published branches are available under Remote · GitHub.
gitLimited: Results are limited. Check the full list on your Git provider.
gitChangesHelp: Select a file to compare it. Git actions require explicit confirmation; no automatic deletion.
gitDiffHelp: Changes compared with the current commit (including staged and unstaged changes).
gitDiffError: Unable to load the comparison. Refresh the working copy.
gitUntracked: New file, not yet tracked. Open it to inspect its content.
gitNoTextDiff: No text comparison available (binary file, conflict or metadata-only change).
gitGithubError: GitHub unavailable or access denied. Check this resource's token and permissions.
gitProviderUnsupported: PRs and checks are currently available for github.com. Files and branches work with other Git hosts.
gitMergeUnknown: Conflict detection in progress or unavailable.
gitNoChecks: No checks reported. This does not mean a merge is approved.
gitMergeHelp: Checks alone do not authorize a merge. GitHub reviews and branch protections still apply. The state is rechecked before merging.
gitActionBusy: Wait until all active agents and Git operations on this server have finished.
gitActionAgentStateUnknown: Unable to verify agent inactivity. Restore the agent service connection before retrying.
gitActionStale: Git changed since your review. Close this window, refresh and review again.
gitActionMergeBlocked: Merge blocked: check status, reviews, conflicts and branch protections on GitHub.
gitActionInProgress: Finish the current merge, rebase or conflict resolution first.
gitActionBranchRequired: Select a named local branch first.
gitActionHttpsRequired: Push from this panel currently requires an HTTPS Git resource without credentials in its URL.
gitActionTokenRequired: Configure a GitHub token with merge permissions for this resource.
gitActionIdentityRequired: Committing requires a signed-in person with a valid name and email in their profile. Have these details completed in People before trying again.
gitAuthorFromSession: The author and email come from the signed-in person. These fields cannot be edited here and will be verified by the server.
gitActionOutcomeUnknown: The connection ended before confirmation. Refresh the PR on GitHub before retrying; it may already be merged.
gitActionFailed: Operation failed or its outcome is unknown. Refresh Git and verify before retrying.
gitActionStagedHelp: Commit includes staged changes only. Prepare them with Git or your agent; unstaged edits are preserved.
gitActionPushHelp: Publish only the reviewed commit to the same branch on the configured remote. No force push, deletion or automatic merge. Uncommitted edits are not published.
gitActionCommitHelp: Review the staged changes below. Only this frozen index will be committed; unstaged files are left untouched. Hooks and signing are not executed by this panel.
gitActionMergeHelp: Creates a merge commit on the PR target branch. Checks and revisions are rechecked on the server. GitHub branch protections apply. The local copy is not updated and no branch is deleted.
